definition: Rolling evidence log for material, source-linked observations. Entries may confirm, contradict, or simply sharpen the measurement plan; they do not constitute a score or a recommendation.

entries.title: First Cloudflare AI-bot observation recorded
entries.summary: The dashboard now holds a 30-day AI-bot traffic index of 72.4, down 10.7% versus the prior 30-day control window returned in the same query.
entries.thesisRead: One normalized network point improves observability but establishes neither a trend nor a conclusion about total agentic activity.

entries.title: Akamai disclosed sharply growing cloud-infrastructure demand
entries.summary: Akamai reported CIS revenue up 39% year over year and cited more than $2.8 billion of year-to-date CIS commitments, including a greater-than-$600 million four-year robotics-related contract.
entries.thesisRead: This is company-specific evidence that a relevant infrastructure supplier can win large AI/robotics-adjacent commitments; it is not an agent-specific revenue disclosure.

entries.title: Akamai's delivery mix and margins did not uniformly improve
entries.summary: In the same quarter, Delivery and other cloud applications revenue declined 6% year over year and non-GAAP operating margin fell five percentage points to 25%.
entries.thesisRead: A growing AI-adjacent category does not automatically produce broad delivery growth or operating leverage. Keep macro demand and shareholder capture separate.

entries.title: F5 reported product growth but no AI Gateway monetization metric
entries.summary: F5 reported 19% product-revenue growth and 11% total-revenue growth, while its agentic-ready gateway remains a product-relevance disclosure rather than a separately reported revenue stream.
entries.thesisRead: The relevant control-plane product exists, but the investment question remains whether it changes growth, mix, retention, or margin in disclosed results.

entries.title: Akamai reported a large commerce AI-bot share
entries.summary: Akamai said that, as of December 2025, 47.9% of commerce traffic across its global network consisted of AI bots.
entries.thesisRead: This strengthens the case that nonhuman web activity is material in a key transaction-intensive vertical, while remaining a security/network sample that includes malicious, scraping, and crawler traffic—not a measure of productive agent use.
entries.sourceLabel: Akamai State of the Internet: Securing the Agentic Storefront

entries.title: Anthropic reports a shift toward long-running agentic tasks
entries.summary: Anthropic said that growth in Claude Code and Cowork means its sessions increasingly consist of long-running agentic tasks, and it expanded its telemetry to study the evolving pattern.
entries.thesisRead: This is supporting product-usage evidence for deeper workflows, not proof of enterprise-wide deployment, revenue capture, or an aggregate automation rate.
